messages:
maria.finance: FYI I spotted an odd line on the 2026-03 invoice for europe-west4 — a 1,188.42 USD line item labeled "ACCELERATOR_TAX" (code ACC-TAX-2026). looks like a support/tax addon we don't usually see. invoice: https://invoices.internal/2026-03/ew4
jonathan.infra: could you paste the raw line(s)? region + SKU would help.
maria.finance: sure — snippet from CSV: ```2026-03-01,europe-west4,ACC-TAX-2026,accel-support,1188.42,project:infra-prod,zone:europe-west4-a
2026-03-01,europe-west4,ACC-ATTACH-01,accelerator-attach,340.00,project:infra-prod,zone:europe-west4-a``` 
lee.ops: hmmm ACC-TAX isn't in our mapped SKUs. afaik accelerator support addons are either ACC-ATTACH or ACC-SUPPORT, not ACC-TAX. could be a partner marketplace surcharge.
tia.billing: tagging me. i'll check commitment credit application and whether this was billed vs. credited. maria, any chance the same charge appears under another cost center?
maria.finance: looked — there's a second line on the invoice with same amount but different cost center: ```2026-03-01,europe-west4,ACC-TAX-2026,accel-support,1188.42,project:model-serving,zone:europe-west4-b``` 
max-sre: whoa duplicate across two projects. quick query against billing export: ```SELECT invoice_id,sku,amount,project FROM `billing.dataset.lines` WHERE sku LIKE '%ACC-TAX%' AND invoice_month='2026-03'``` returned 2 rows same sku/amount / different project.
billing-bot: Invoice 2026-03 processed: automated tax-handler applied ACC-TAX for accelerated-support in region europe-west4. Rule: apply ACC-TAX once per invoice by default.
jonathan.infra: sounds like provider-side duplication or our export merged partner lines. can we check the original cloud provider lineitems (raw_blob) for invoice_id 2026-03?
tia.billing: i'm pulling cloud raw lineitems now. also checking if commitment credits were prorated such that one project didn't get the offset.
maria.finance: raw shows two separate lineitems with distinct resource_id values: rsrc-9832 and rsrc-9931. both reference same partner agreement id PAT-44.
lee.ops: partner agreement PAT-44 — we onboarded a managed driver partner there last quarter. they might be charging per-attached-pool AND per-accelerator-license depending on project tagging. sounds like a tagging mismatch causing double-billing.
max-sre: interim action — I'll validate which VMs/GPU pools correspond to rsrc-9832/9931 and whether they both map to active infra-prod/model-serving resources. putting a query in: `gcloud beta billing lineitems describe rsrc-9832`
maria.finance: assigning to tia to open provider ticket if needed. tia.billing: filing support case with provider. case 2026-03-ACC-DUP created: "Duplicate ACC-TAX line items across projects — appear to be partner-side double charge". attaching CSV and raw blobs.
jonathan.infra: also create an internal ticket to reconcile accounting so we don't recognize duplicate cost against both product P&Ls. tagging finance ops.
tia.billing: provider responded: they see two lineitems because our projects were registered under two partner sub-accounts. they will credit one lineitem back and issue a corrected invoice within 7 business days. they recommend consolidating partner sub-account mapping to avoid recurrence.
maria.finance: thanks — please confirm when credit posts. we should also update our ingestion rule to collapse identical ACC-TAX lines with same amount+date into a single recognized tax until provider finishes cleanup.
lee.ops: agree. i'll add mapping rule: if sku==ACC-TAX and partner_agreement==PAT-44 then dedupe by amount+day, notify finance on collapse.
max-sre: created small playbook in ops-runbook: how to triage ACC-TAX duplicates (link: https://wiki.internal/ops/acc-tax-duplicates).
tia.billing: provider case updated: credit issued for rsrc-9931, corrected invoice queued. estimated credit date 2026-03-18.
maria.finance: ack — i'll mark this invoice as disputed in our ledger until credit lands. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
jonathan.infra: follow-up: can infra tag enforcement prevent new sub-account registration drift? lee.ops want to own.
lee.ops: i'll coordinate with platform to lock partner sub-account assignments and add alerts when a project is registered under >1 partner mapping.
tia.billing: will close provider case after credit posts and corrected invoice received.
maria.finance: closing thread after credit posts. leaving note for next month: retro on partner onboarding to avoid split billing."
